fb_text:
Fall is when solo ops hire their first guy. Winter contracts are coming, the route's too full, and you finally can't do it all yourself.

Nobody warns you about the real onboarding cost. It's not the paycheck — it's everything in your head.

Every gate code. Every "use the side entrance, not the front." Every client quirk you've memorized over two years. None of it lives anywhere but between your ears.

So week one, your phone rings at dinner. Week two, it's ringing at 7 AM. "What's the code at the office park?" "Which building gets serviced first?"

I hit that wall running my commercial plant service here in Atlanta. So I built FieldNotes: you text the details once — gate codes, access notes, client quirks — the same way you'd text a buddy. Your new guy asks the bot instead of calling you.

The knowledge transfer happens before the first phone call, not after the tenth.

Hiring this fall? Get it out of your head first. 30 days free, no credit card:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
